title: Bouken Katsugeki Monomono
overview:
Fun to use, fun to collect - there are 200 kinds of items! Do your best and collect them all!!

Bouken Katsugeki Monomono is a dungeon-crawling RPG. The young hero Gen heads into a cave in search of a being with mysterious powers, hoping to cure his childhood friend Yuki, who has fallen ill.

The dungeon changes shape every time you enter, and enemies can be seen roaming the overhead map before you meet them. Gen fights with whatever he finds, from swords to everyday objects such as brooms and musical instruments, and every item has its own battle animation. Fights play out side-on, closer to a one-on-one fighting game than a menu battle. Each item you collect is recorded in the Monomono Book, letting you build your own encyclopedia of finds.

- 200 kinds of items to use and collect
- Random dungeons that change on every visit
- One player, memory backup saves

使って楽しい集めて楽しい、アイテムの数は二〇〇種類！がんばって全部集めよう！！
